content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Wander the old terraces and let the mountain wind tell its stories."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Step inside for the gold-leaf altars and the huge paintings that mix two worlds."},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A sweet little stop to see cacao turned into chocolate, with a taste or two along the way."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Inca stonework meets colonial walls here, and the old sun temple still holds its quiet power."},{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The plaza is the city's living room, perfect for watching Cusco settle into the evening."},{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The white Christ looks over the red rooftops, a fine first view of the whole valley."},{"poi_id":"p19","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A warm, lively kitchen with proper vegetarian choices and a good pisco sour to end the day."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"Giant Inca stones with a view over the whole city, and a story in every block."},{"poi_id":"p16","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A fancy Andean table where even the vegetables get the royal treatment."},{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Old Inca gold and woven stories under one roof, perfect for a history lover."},{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"A riot of fruit, flowers and market chatter, with a juice stand on every corner."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Cobbled lanes and little workshops where the city feels like a village."},{"poi_id":"p18","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A cosy, honest kitchen with a wood-fired oven and plenty for the herbivores."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Wander the terraces and watch the valley unfold below the old stones."},{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The salt pans glint like a thousand little mirrors on the hillside."},{"poi_id":"p11","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Giant rings carved into the earth, an old Inca experiment in growing things."}]}
Colonial charm, Inca stones, market colours, the Sacred Valley and a sweet goodbye — your Cusco trip is complete, amigo.
